description: This file defines a class for configuring and interacting with Vertex AI's Imagen image generation models. It includes methods for parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response processing specific to Vertex AI's image generation API.

classes.name: VertexAIImagenImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI Imagen image generation, integrating base image generation settings with VertexLLM functionalities and providing methods to handle parameter mapping, endpoint URL creation, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.
